correctness.rationale: Actual arclength projection density is sqrt(1+epsilon²x²/(1-x²))/Iepsilon, with nonnegative exceptional mixture mass O(epsilon² log). For sorted uniform-x triples, density is 3/4 and the middle-angle dot product forces st<4epsilon². Same-branch and one-neighbor-matching sign patterns contribute lower order by the global half-Holder sqrt(1-x²) bound. In the two opposite-middle patterns the middle positivity is st<4epsilon²(1-x²)+o(epsilon²) on compact interiors; integrating the hyperbolic region gives area 8epsilon²(1-x²)log, then 3/4 times 2/8 and integration over x gives precisely coefficient 2. The other two vertex angles exclude only O(epsilon²) layers. Jacobian of s=epsilon^lambda, t=4epsilon²(1-x²)u/s yields product conditional law. Exceptional arclength draws enter the acute event only O(epsilon^4 log²), so transfer of conditioning is legitimate. All error orders are as epsilon->0, not claimed finite-epsilon exactness.
